entities.summary: Loveland is a town in Tillman County, Oklahoma, United States. It is located about 38 miles southwest of Lawton, Oklahoma. The population was 13 at the 2020 Census. Loveland once had a post office that has since closed. The post office was popular around Valentine's Day, when people often drove many miles to have their valentines postmarked "Loveland".
